title: Marked-code count coordinate
statement: For any exponential BFS machine state $st$, the coordinate at index $15$ of its counter vector is its marked-code count $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $st$ is an exponential BFS machine state
replaced:
Let $st$ be a state with natural-number registers
$N,Lg,s,s1,X,w,K,Bs,U,V,T,T2,Z,C,ch,c,c1$, and let $v(st)$ be the vector of these
registers in the displayed order. The coordinate of $v(st)$ at index $15$ is $c$.
